positive_face_definition: Validated with the 20260721_221444 capture: the CAD +Z face is the physical positive (non-grasp) side. CAD -Z facing the camera is the physical reverse (grasp) side.
grasp_lateral_offset_rule: In camera image coordinates, compare the projected wide-head centre with the projected CAD workpiece centroid. Wide head left of the centroid uses -8 mm along grasp-frame +Y; wide head right uses +8 mm along grasp-frame +Y.
